headline: No documented interaction pathway; both open-source docs-only profiles show no network egress or I/O surfaces, so pairwise risks are effectively blocked.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Neither profile exposes I/O surfaces or a shared channel, and both list network_egress as none. With no documented bridge between awesome-python and data-engineering-zoomcamp, there is no plausible default prompt-injection pathway.
conditions: IF either agent is later connected to a shared clipboard, filesystem, or MCP server, reassess injection risk.
mitigations: Keep both agents isolated from shared clipboard and shared folders.
Do not add an MCP bridge without provenance tracking.
requires-engineering: add explicit input provenance checks if a shared channel is introduced.

B_data_leakage.rationale: Both profiles are docs-only, open-source, and show no data classes touched, no I/O surfaces, and no network egress. That makes cross-agent leakage of sensitive data unsubstantiated for this pair as configured.
conditions: IF either agent is given access to sensitive files or an upload path, leakage risk must be re-evaluated.
mitigations: Avoid mounting sensitive workspaces into either agent.
Keep both agents offline or network-blocked.
requires-engineering: add DLP controls before any file-sharing integration.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: No write, network, git, or database capabilities are documented for either agent, and both io_surfaces and concurrency_model are empty. Without overlapping mutable resources, capability conflict is not plausible.
conditions: IF either agent gains write access to the same directory or repository, conflict risk changes.
mitigations: Do not co-locate them on a shared mutable workspace.
requires-engineering: introduce locking if shared writes are added later.

D_cascading_error.rationale: The profiles do not show either agent producing actionable outputs or consuming the other's outputs by default. With no I/O surfaces and no downstream action authority, there is no documented cascade from one agent into the other.
conditions: IF one agent's output is later used as authoritative input to the other, verify that step explicitly.
mitigations: Insert a human review step between any future handoff.
Keep outputs as reference-only, not authoritative.
requires-engineering: add validation gates before automated downstream actions.

E_compliance.rationale: No data residency, certification, retention, or regulated data classes are documented for either awesome-python or data-engineering-zoomcamp. Because the pair touches no declared sensitive data, there is no compliance mismatch to assess from the profiles alone.
conditions: IF either profile later declares PHI, EU PII, or retention obligations, reassess compliance.
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of both agents.
requires-engineering: add residency and retention policy enforcement if sensitive data is introduced.
